items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Were you in the band before Faiso or after Faiso? ... Must've been after Faiso.

ctx.x: He's been a little. Were you in the band before Faiso or after Faiso?
Must've been after Faiso. Must've been after Faiso. Faiso left here way early twenties. What become of him? I don't know.
I don't know where he is. Never did hear either. No. I think I haven't thought to ask anybody really what's happening. No, no.
